title: Introduce cron and proactive agent job boundaries
description: AstrBot CronJobManager stores scheduled jobs, wakes the main agent with special events, injects conversation history, and persists agent history. Rust should define cron/proactive job scheduling and active-agent wake boundaries before such logic grows inside runtime handle, plugin tools, or WebChat routes.

files.change: Define typed basic and active-agent job metadata independent of scheduler implementation.
Keep proactive agent request construction outside plugin tools and WebChat transport.

criteria: Runtime supervises cron as a service boundary rather than owning job logic.
Cron storage and scheduling can be tested without a live WebChat route.
Active-agent wake events enter the same pipeline/event boundary as platform messages.
